title: Virology and Vaccine Unit
objective: Complete virology and vaccine production workflow from sample intake through virus culture to vaccine development
protocol: Standard Virology and Vaccine Production Protocol
content: Virology and Vaccine Unit notebook template with 14 predefined workflow pages from sample intake through preclinical and clinical trials.

pages.title: Sample Intake and Registration
pages.instructions: Sample Arrival: Receive pre-labeled or labeled samples (clinical specimens or research samples). Registration: Enter metadata (Sample ID, Source, Type, Date/time), assign test type (Viral or Bacterial testing), link to project/study if applicable.
pages.content: Stage 1: Sample Intake and Registration - Sample arrival verification and metadata entry

manifestColumns.label: Sample ID
manifestColumns.description: Unique identifier assigned to the clinical or research sample at intake.

manifestColumns.label: Sample Type
manifestColumns.description: Type of material (e.g., clinical specimen, virus stock, cell culture supernatant).

manifestColumns.label: Collection Date & Time
manifestColumns.description: Date and time the sample was collected or produced.

manifestColumns.label: Source
manifestColumns.description: Origin of the sample — patient, animal model, environmental isolate, or cell culture.

manifestColumns.label: Reception Date & Time
manifestColumns.description: Date and time the sample was formally received at the virology unit.

manifestColumns.label: Test Type
manifestColumns.description: Specific test or assay requested for this sample (e.g., PCR, serology, culture).

manifestColumns.label: Project/Study
manifestColumns.description: Name or ID of the research project or study this sample is linked to.

manifestColumns.label: Batch ID
manifestColumns.description: Identifier for the production batch this sample belongs to.

manifestColumns.label: Production Stage
manifestColumns.description: Current stage in the virus production or vaccine development pipeline.

manifestColumns.label: Cell Line Used
manifestColumns.description: Name of the cell line used for virus propagation or culture.

manifestColumns.label: Passage Number
manifestColumns.description: Number of times the virus or cell culture has been serially passaged.

manifestColumns.label: Titer Values
manifestColumns.description: Quantitative measure of viral concentration (e.g., TCID50/mL, PFU/mL).

manifestColumns.label: QC Results
manifestColumns.description: Summary result of quality control tests performed on this batch.

manifestColumns.label: Formulation Details
manifestColumns.description: Description of stabilizers, adjuvants, or buffers added during formulation.

manifestColumns.label: Storage Condition on Arrival
manifestColumns.description: Temperature or storage state of the sample when it arrived at the laboratory.

manifestColumns.label: Transport Temperature
manifestColumns.description: Temperature maintained during transit from origin to the laboratory.

manifestColumns.label: Receiving Personnel
manifestColumns.description: Name or staff ID of the laboratory personnel who received the sample.

manifestColumns.label: Manifest Verification Status
manifestColumns.description: Status of verification of this sample against the delivery manifest.

manifestColumns.label: Notes
manifestColumns.description: Any additional observations or comments about this sample at intake.
manifestColumns.example: Partial thaw detected on arrival; stored immediately

pages.title: Media Preparation
pages.instructions: Log materials used in media preparation with full traceability. Select media, reagents (with lot numbers and expiry dates), and equipment. Record sterilization parameters (temperature, time, pressure).
pages.content: Media Preparation - Material logging and sterilization tracking

pages.title: Cell Culture
pages.instructions: Grow host cells where the virus will be propagated. Track cell line (e.g., Vero, MDCK), passage number, and growth conditions (temperature, CO2 percentage, humidity). Record seeding density, flask type, and media volume.
pages.content: Cell Culture - Host cell growth and tracking

pages.title: Quality Control
pages.instructions: Validate cell viability and sterility. Log QC results including viability percentage (0-100%), sterility result (Pass/Fail), test method, acceptance criteria, and any deviation notes.
pages.content: Quality Control - Cell viability and sterility validation

pages.title: Virus Culture
pages.instructions: Inoculate cells with virus. Record virus strain, culture conditions (temperature, CO2 percentage, duration), and any observations during the culture period.
pages.content: Virus Culture - Virus inoculation and culture condition tracking

pages.title: Dark Room Imaging
pages.instructions: Perform imaging or fluorescence analysis on virus culture samples. Store image data (Image ID), record CPE (Cytopathic Effect) observations, measure fluorescence intensity, and document any relevant observations.
pages.content: Dark Room Imaging - Capture image data and fluorescence analysis results

pages.title: Formulation
pages.instructions: Prepare viral product while recording formulation details. Document stabilizers, preservatives, virus concentration, buffer composition, batch number, and formulation notes for traceability.
pages.content: Formulation - Prepare viral product and document formulation details

pages.title: Feeding
pages.instructions: Log culture feeding and maintenance activities. Record feeding schedule and reagents used from inventory with full traceability. Document feeding date, time, schedule (e.g., Daily, Every 2 days), reagents used, volume, and observations (e.g., cell confluence, media color, contamination check).
pages.content: Feeding - Culture feeding and maintenance activity log

pages.title: Packaging
pages.instructions: Log final product packaging specifications. Record batch ID, vial type (glass vial 2mL/5mL/10mL, plastic vial, ampoule), fill volume, labeling information (product name, batch number, expiry date, storage instructions, warnings), packaging date, expiry date, and storage conditions for regulatory compliance and traceability.
pages.content: Packaging - Final product packaging specifications and traceability

pages.title: Virus Isolation
pages.instructions: Isolate virus from culture batches. Record isolation batch ID, link to source culture batch, method, virus strain, and passage number.
pages.content: Virus Isolation - Isolate virus from culture with full traceability

pages.title: Titer Measurement
pages.instructions: Quantify viral load using various assay methods. Record titer values (TCID50, PFU/ml, FFU/ml, HA Units, qPCR copies/ml) with dilution factors and calculation methods.
pages.content: Titer Measurement - Quantify viral load with full traceability

pages.title: Genome Sequencing
pages.instructions: Viral genome analysis - record FASTA files and GenBank accession data
pages.content: Genome Sequencing - Viral genome analysis and data submission

pages.title: Seed Virus Production
pages.instructions: Select strain for vaccine - document seed virus batch ID and selection criteria
pages.content: Seed Virus Production - Strain selection and seed virus batch documentation

pages.title: Preclinical & Clinical Trials
pages.instructions: Manage preclinical (animal) and clinical (human) trials - track trial phases, outcomes, and regulatory submissions
pages.content: Preclinical & Clinical Trials - Trial management and regulatory submissions
